title: Entropy Density of Uniquely Ergodic Measures for Full Shifts over Amenable Residually Finite Groups
summary: We study entropy density for full shifts over amenable residually finite groups. Entropy density means that every invariant measure can be approximated in the weak$^*$ topology, together with its entropy, by measures from a distinguished family. In symbolic dynamics it is known, by a result of Weiss, that uniquely ergodic measures are entropy dense among ergodic measures for the shift action of $\mathbb Z$.
